notes.title: Ah, some critical fixes
notes.content:
We weren't good enough and missed some annoying bugs.
[list]
[*] Default sounds volume is 100% now
[*] After the restart in 1st game part, the last quest accidentally was ignored
[*] In the 2nd game part, you can't open the kitchen door unless you will close the neighbor's entrance door.
[*] And a few tiny bugs, I hope no one knows about
[/list]
[b]Thank you for the feedback![/b]
We will make additional improvements in the near future based on your comments.
